origin.note: Walks 5 to 7 carried a reminder ask whose merge added a real email schedule; the fixture records reminders in an outbox instead of sending.

title: Remind recipients who have not opened
objective: Let the people in a library remind the recipients who have not opened a document. POST /api/documents/:id/reminders (members only, 404 otherwise) queues one reminder for each of the document's links that nobody but the owner has opened: a row { to, linkId, docId, at } in store.db.outbox (at is the store clock). A link already reminded less than 72 hours ago is skipped. It answers 200 { queued: [emails], skipped: [emails] }. Nothing is sent here; the outbox is the record.
acceptance: A reminder is queued for each link nobody but the owner opened (only legal@contoso.example for d4)
Links a recipient opened get none (d1)
A second press inside 72 hours skips; after 72 hours it queues again
The outbox rows carry to, linkId, docId and the store time
plan_summary: An outbox array in data, a reminders route and a pure selection rule in store.mjs.
